dialogue: Find me floor lamps with bronze finish for living room, and price lower than 280.00 dollars
I'd like an arc floor lamp with a drum shade. And lower the price range
Prefer a plain white or neutral linen drum shade, not patterned.

agent_final_statement: This 71.5-inch arc floor lamp has a drum shade, oil-rubbed bronze finish, and costs $279.99, satisfying all must-haves. Its patterned shade and near-limit price do not meet the shade and lower-price preferences, but it is the best supported bronze option found.

agent_product.title: Craftsman Mosaic Bronze Downbridge Arc Floor Lamp - Giclee Glow
agent_product.product_category: Tools & Home Improvement › Lighting & Ceiling Fans › Lamps & Shades › Floor Lamps
agent_product.description: Add style with this contemporary arching floor lamp. This design offers a modern look with a warm, handsome touch. It features an oil-rubbed bronze finish and a drum shade with a Craftsman Mosaic giclee pattern and a bottom diffuser to prevent glare. The stem switch allows for two different lighting levels for ultimate convenience.
bullet_points: Overall: 71 1/2" high. Base is 14" wide. Shade is 16" across the top x 16" across the bottom x 5 1/2" high.
Takes two maximum 100 watt standard base bulbs (not included).
4-position stem column switch. Switch positions: Right bulb on, left bulb on, both on, both off.
Contemporary arc floor lamp from Giclee Glow. Includes 8' of brown cord.
Oil rubbed bronze finish. Metal construction. Craftsman Mosaic giclee pattern drum shade with diffuser.

Paired with a rounded gem-shaped globe shade.
